info.title: Money Planner API
info.description: Everything except `/health` and `/auth` needs a signed-in user: send the session token as `Authorization: Bearer`, or let the browser send the session cookie. Amounts are integers in grosze (12.34 PLN is 1234).

get.description: Returns ok while the server is running.

post.description: Always answers 204, whether or not the address has an account. The e-mail has a link (opened in the browser app) and a 6-digit code (typed in the mobile app), valid for 15 minutes.
post.summary: E-mail a sign-in link and code

post.description: Creates the account on the first sign-in. A code stops working after 5 wrong tries.
post.summary: Sign in with the code from the e-mail
Sign in with the token from the e-mailed link

post.description: The app signs in with Google and sends the ID token it got. The token has to be for one of this server's Google client ids and its e-mail address verified by Google. Creates the account on the first sign-in; an account with the same address is the same account.
post.summary: Sign in with a Google ID token

post.description: For the browser app, which gets an access token from Google's popup instead of an ID token. The server asks Google whom the token was issued to and refuses one that was not issued to one of its client ids or whose address Google has not verified. Otherwise the same as the ID token sign-in.
post.summary: Sign in with a Google access token

post.description: The token stops working at once and the cookie is cleared.

get.description: Every envelope the user can see, top-level ones and their sub-envelopes, by name.

delete.description: Removes its sub-envelopes, expenses and allocations too; the money allocated to it goes back to the pools of the people who put it in.

get.description: Of the envelope and, for a top-level one, its sub-envelopes (all envelopes when none is named). Newest first.

post.description: A negative amount takes money back. Fails with 409 when an envelope would not have it, or when more would be assigned to sub-envelopes than the user put into the parent. A pool that goes below zero is allowed.
post.summary: Put money into an envelope or take it out

put.description: Only the user who made it can.

delete.description: Only the user who made it can.

get.description: Of the envelopes the user can see, newest first. Defaults to 50 rows, at most 200.

put.description: Its author and the owner of the envelope can. The new envelope has to be one the user can see.

delete.description: Its author and the owner of the envelope can.

put.description: Setting `active` to false pauses the rule.

delete.description: Expenses it already generated are kept.

post.description: Adds one expense for every active rule not applied for this `from` yet (dated today when today is in the stretch, else `from`). Safe to call repeatedly.
post.summary: Apply the recurring rules to a stretch of time

get.description: Income, what was put into envelopes and spent between the two days (both included), the pool that is left, and the figures of every envelope. Balances roll over from earlier days.
get.summary: Money over a stretch of time

get.description: Every month from the first with activity until now, newest first.
A full snapshot as JSON, with ids and timestamps.

post.description: Row counts of the document next to the current data. Changes nothing.
Replaces ALL current data with the document, in one transaction.
Converts the old local format (integer ids, amounts in zloty) and replaces ALL current data.
post.summary: Import a backup of the offline app

get.description: Columns: Envelope, Subenvelope, Amount, Date, Note.

post.description: Creates missing envelopes by name and skips rows that already exist.

Transport.description: `token` returns the session token in the response body (mobile apps); `cookie` sets it as an HTTP-only cookie instead (browser apps).
